auth.forgot.title: Reset your password
auth.forgot.intro: Enter your username or e-mail address. If an account exists, we will e-mail a link to reset the password.

auth.reset.title: Set a new password
auth.reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

auth.activate.intro: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.

users.email.readonly: Changed only with “Change e-mail” above, with a reason.

users.invite.help: The e-mail holds a link to set a password. You can send it again later.
users.reason.help: Kept with the change in the audit log.
users.action.invite.title: Send the invitation to {name}?
users.action.invite.effect: {name} gets an e-mail with a link to set a password. An earlier unused link stops working.
users.action.activate.title: Activate {name}?
users.action.activate.effect: {name} can sign in again and takes one named user place of the licence.
users.action.lock.title: Lock {name}?
users.action.lock.effect: {name} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you unlock the account.
users.action.unlock.title: Unlock {name}?
users.action.unlock.effect: {name} can sign in again. The count of failed attempts starts again.
users.action.disable.title: Disable {name}?
users.action.disable.effect: {name} is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in. The history stays. The named user place is freed.
users.action.archive.title: Archive {name}?
users.action.archive.effect: {name} is closed for good: no sign-in and no way back. The history stays.
users.action.password-reset-link.title: Send a password reset link to {name}?
users.action.password-reset-link.effect: {name} gets an e-mail with a link to choose a new password. The old password keeps working until they use it.
users.action.force-password-change.title: Force {name} to change the password?
users.action.force-password-change.effec: At the next sign-in {name} must choose a new password before doing anything else.
users.action.reset-mfa.title: Reset the second step of {name}?
users.action.reset-mfa.effect: All second-step methods and recovery codes of {name} are removed, and remembered browsers are forgotten. They set it up again at the next sign-in if the company requires it.
users.action.revoke-sessions.title: Sign {name} out everywhere?
users.action.revoke-sessions.effect: Every session and remembered browser of {name} ends now. They sign in again with their password.
users.action.email.title: Change the e-mail address of {name}?
users.action.email.effect: Reset links and codes for {name} go to the new address from now on. For people with wide access a second administrator must approve first.
users.email.pendingHelp: The address must not be used by anyone else to sign in.
users.done.force-password-change: {name} must choose a new password at the next sign-in.
users.done.reset-mfa: The second step of {name} was reset.
users.done.email: The e-mail address of {name} was changed.
users.done.emailPending: The change for {name} is waiting for a second administrator. Find it under Approvals.

users.roles.empty.body: Without a role the person can sign in but sees almost nothing.
